title: lifedraft input contract — universal $defs: the transaction_costs[] block
$comment: Fragment of the universal input contract, merged into schema/input_schema.json by input_contract.load_universal_schema() -- see that function and compose_schema() for the exact, total merge rule. This file is a FRAGMENT, not a standalone schema: its "#/$defs/..." references resolve only in the composed document. Issue #139: one-time costs and credits attached to a dated financial event (refinance origination fees, discharge/quittance fees, title insurance, appraisal, transfer-in rebates and match bonuses). Each entry is one directional, dated, one-off balance-sheet delta; the adapter folds its dated cash-flow legs into the engine's existing cash_flows channel so every objective sees them (DP#8). Optional and deliberately NOT in the spine's required list (DP#16: auto-include on trigger data) -- a document that omits transaction_costs[] has no such frictions, and the run is unchanged (the golden invariant does not move, DP#32).

id.description: A stable identifier for this one-time leg (e.g. 'refinance_origination_2026').

label.description: What the leg is for (e.g. 'lender origination fees', 'title insurance premium', 'transfer-in rebate'). Free text, a FACT.

kind.description: Issue #139. The direction of this one-time balance-sheet leg, explicit and never collapsed into the sign of an amount (DP#32): 'cost' = the household PAYS (origination/discharge fees, title insurance, appraisal, transfer-out fees); 'credit' = the household RECEIVES (transfer-in reimbursement, asset match bonus). A genuine zero (no net cost) is still a declarable 0 amount within either direction.

date.description: The date the leg fires. The adapter maps the calendar year of this date; a credit spread over an installment period fires its first annual leg this year.

amount.description: The non-negative MAGNITUDE of the leg, in the document's currency/dollars units. The direction is carried by `kind`, never by a negative literal here (DP#32: a $-zero cost is real and distinct from a credit). The household declares the net after-tax figure.

installment_years.description: Issue #139. Optional: spread the amount across this many equal ANNUAL legs starting in the date's calendar year. A transfer-in match paid over a 24-month installment period is therefore not priced as one year-0 lump (a one-time delta between near-identical custodian choices is exactly what a fee comparison wants, and a lump mis-prices the crossover). Omit for the ordinary closing-day lump that fires entirely in the date's year. Default: 1 (a single leg).
